name: Campingplatz Seewang
beschreibung: The Campingplatz Seewang is located in the municipality of Tristach near Lienz in Osttirol. It lies directly on the Tristacher See, which invites guests to swim in summer. The surrounding mountain landscape of the Lienzer Dolomiten offers a network of hiking and climbing routes. In winter, the ski areas Zettersfeld and Hochstein serve as local recreation destinations. The site has sanitary buildings, electrical hookups, and a children's playground. A restaurant provides guests with regional cuisine. The atmosphere is quiet and geared toward families. Guests can expect a nature-oriented stay in the Alps.
